verdict.rationale: Hightouch exposes a REST API (with API-key auth) covering syncs, models, sources, and destinations, and Git Sync lets teams manage workspace resources programmatically — both of which support scripted/headless automation, and syncs can run on a schedule or via API trigger rather than only through the UI. However, there is no documented CLI, no CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration), and the openapi/docs.md probes returned 404, so tooling for headless orchestration is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guide, official CLI, and OpenAPI spec/schema for automated tooling.
